verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ תּ֭וֹכָחוֹת מַקְשֶׁה־עֹ֑רֶף פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.en: He that being often reproved hardeneth his neck Shall suddenly be broken, and that without remedy.

verses.he: בִּרְב֣וֹת צַ֭דִּיקִים יִשְׂמַ֣ח הָעָ֑ם וּבִמְשֹׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע יֵאָ֥נַֽח עָֽם׃
verses.en: When the righteous are increased, the people rejoice; But when the wicked beareth rule, the people sigh.

verses.he: אִֽישׁ־אֹהֵ֣ב חָ֭כְמָה יְשַׂמַּ֣ח אָבִ֑יו וְרֹעֶ֥ה ז֝וֹנ֗וֹת יְאַבֶּד־הֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father; But he that keepeth company with harlots wasteth his substance.

verses.he: מֶ֗לֶךְ בְּ֭מִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִ֣יד אָ֑רֶץ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּרוּמ֣וֹת יֶֽהֶרְסֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: The king by justice establisheth the land; But he that exacteth gifts overthroweth it.

verses.he: גֶּ֭בֶר מַחֲלִ֣יק עַל־רֵעֵ֑הוּ רֶ֝֗שֶׁת פּוֹרֵ֥שׂ עַל־פְּעָמָֽיו׃
verses.en: A man that flattereth his neighbour Spreadeth a net for his steps.

verses.he: בְּפֶ֤שַֽׁע אִ֣ישׁ רָ֣ע מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יָר֥וּן וְשָׂמֵֽחַ׃
verses.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare; But the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

verses.he: יֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק דִּ֣ין דַּלִּ֑ים רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לֹא־יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃
verses.en: The righteous taketh knowledge of the cause of the poor; The wicked understandeth not knowledge.

verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָ֭צוֹן יָפִ֣יחוּ קִרְיָ֑ה וַ֝חֲכָמִ֗ים יָשִׁ֥יבוּ אָֽף׃
verses.en: Scornful men set a city in a blaze; But wise men turn away wrath.

verses.he: אִֽישׁ־חָכָ֗ם נִ֭שְׁפָּט אֶת־אִ֣ישׁ אֱוִ֑יל וְרָגַ֥ז וְ֝שָׂחַ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין נָֽחַת׃
verses.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, Whether he be angry or laugh, there will be no rest.

verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֣י דָ֭מִים יִשְׂנְאוּ־תָ֑ם וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: The men of blood hate him that is sincere; And as for the upright, they seek his life.

verses.he: כָּל־ר֭וּחוֹ יוֹצִ֣יא כְסִ֑יל וְ֝חָכָ֗ם בְּאָח֥וֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: A fool spendeth all his spirit; But a wise man stilleth it within him.

verses.he: מֹ֭שֵׁל מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־דְּבַר־שָׁ֑קֶר כָּֽל־מְשָׁרְתָ֥יו רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.en: If a ruler hearkeneth to falsehood, All his servants are wicked.

verses.he: רָ֤שׁ וְאִ֣ישׁ תְּכָכִ֣ים נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ מֵ֤אִיר־עֵינֵ֖י שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: The poor man and the oppressor meet together; The LORD giveth light to the eyes of them both.

verses.he: מֶ֤לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֣ט בֶּֽאֱמֶ֣ת דַּלִּ֑ים כִּ֝סְא֗וֹ לָעַ֥ד יִכּֽוֹן׃
verses.en: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, His throne shall be established for ever.

verses.he: שֵׁ֣בֶט וְ֭תוֹכַחַת יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה וְנַ֥עַר מְ֝שֻׁלָּ֗ח מֵבִ֥ישׁ אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom; But a child left to himself causeth shame to his mother.

verses.he: בִּרְב֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים יִרְבֶּה־פָּ֑שַׁע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים בְּֽמַפַּלְתָּ֥ם יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.en: When the wicked are increased, transgression increaseth; But the righteous shall gaze upon their fall.

verses.he: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ וִֽינִיחֶ֑ךָ וְיִתֵּ֖ן מַעֲדַנִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.en: Correct thy son, and he will give thee rest; Yea, he will give delight unto thy soul.

verses.he: בְּאֵ֣ין חָ֭זוֹן יִפָּ֣רַֽע עָ֑ם וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹרָ֣ה אַשְׁרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; But he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

verses.he: בִּ֭דְבָרִים לֹא־יִוָּ֣סֶר עָ֑בֶד כִּֽי־יָ֝בִ֗ין וְאֵ֣ין מַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.en: A servant will not be corrected by words; For though he understand, there will be no response.

verses.he: חָזִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ אָ֣ץ בִּדְבָרָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

verses.he: מְפַנֵּ֣ק מִנֹּ֣עַר עַבְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝אַחֲרִית֗וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנֽוֹן׃
verses.en: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child Shall have him become master at the last.

verses.he: אִֽישׁ־אַ֭ף יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבַ֖עַל חֵמָ֣ה רַב־פָּֽשַׁע׃
verses.en: An angry man stirreth up strife, And a wrathful man aboundeth in transgression.

verses.he: גַּאֲוַ֣ת אָ֭דָם תַּשְׁפִּילֶ֑נּוּ וּשְׁפַל־ר֝֗וּחַ יִתְמֹ֥ךְ כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: A man’s pride shall bring him low; But he that is of a lowly spirit shall attain to honour.

verses.he: חוֹלֵ֣ק עִם־גַּ֭נָּב שׂוֹנֵ֣א נַפְשׁ֑וֹ אָלָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יַגִּֽיד׃
verses.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: He heareth the adjuration and uttereth nothing.

verses.he: חֶרְדַּ֣ת אָ֭דָם יִתֵּ֣ן מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה יְשֻׂגָּֽב׃
verses.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare; But whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be set up on high.

verses.he: רַ֭בִּים מְבַקְשִׁ֣ים פְּנֵי־מוֹשֵׁ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּט־אִֽישׁ׃
verses.en: Many seek the ruler’s favour; But a man’s judgment cometh from the LORD.

verses.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים אִ֣ישׁ עָ֑וֶל וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע יְשַׁר־דָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.en: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; And he that is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.
